assets.label: Halle ouverte du marché
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent PNG building sprite for a detailed 2.5D Yautja Homeworld game.
Create exactly ONE full-size open CLAN MARKET HALL, EMPTY of loose merchandise, inhabitants and stalls. A complete long building, 18 metres wide, 10 metres deep, 8 metres tall; widely spaced substantial pillars, three tall open passage bays at front, entrances 3.2 metres high minimum. Long ribbed bronze canopy roof supported on monumental dark basalt piers, elevated fine roof fins, trapezoidal technology joints and restrained warm amber lamps inset in pillars. Practical hunting-clan architecture from the Predator universe: black volcanic stone, worn gunmetal, dull aged bronze, tiny worn rust-red canopy fabric accents. Heavy, ancient, alien engineering, restrained skull-free angular ornament. This is a new game adaptation, not a reproduction of a claimed movie building.
VIEW: locked orthographic projection, camera looking down 35 degrees, camera azimuth/yaw 0 degrees, front facade horizontal and upright, roof depth visible. No perspective convergence, no 45-degree isometric rotation. Full realistic architectural proportions, slender full-height doorways, no condensed cute miniature proportions.
LIGHTING: soft neutral light from upper left, readable dark materials, no fog.
COMPOSITION: wide landscape canvas. Entire single building including roof tips and all foundations centered within the middle 70 percent of the image; at least 12 percent EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on ALL FOUR sides. Nothing may approach the border. No ground plane, no landscape or scene, no cast shadow outside foundation, no background glow.
Output genuinely transparent alpha background, crisp clean silhouette. NO lettering, NO labels, NO diagram, NO contact sheet, NO border, NO fake checkerboard, NO characters, NO animals, NO separate objects.
